SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT TT.*, CASE WHEN TT.EQUIPTCODETEMP IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE TT.EQUIPTCODETEMP END AS EQUIPTCODE FROM (SELECT A.*, D.EQUIPTNAME, D.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTCODETEMP, M.MAXELNTMPLID, M.METHODNAME, S1.SOLNAME AS SOL1NAME, S2.SOLNAME AS SOL2NAME, S1.SOLNO AS SOL1NO, S2.SOLNO AS SOL2NO, R.REAGENTNAME, U.ORGID AS RUNANALYSISORGID FROM T_EMC_RUN A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT D ON A.EQUIPTID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD M ON A.METHODID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_SOL S1 ON A.SOL1ID = S1.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_SOL S2 ON A.SOL2ID = S2.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_REAGENT R ON A.REAGENTID = R.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER U ON A.ANALYSISUSERID = U.ID ) TT) T
AND
AND ( T.CHECKUSERID = #{checkUserId} OR T.CHECKUSERID IS NULL OR T.CHECKUSERID = '')
AND (T.ANALYSISUSERID = #{analysisUserId} OR (INSTR( ',' || T.CHECKUSERID || ',',',' || #{checkUserId} || ',' ) > 0))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.RUNID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS IN ('audit', 'qcAudit') AND OT.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId} AND OT.PROJID = #{projId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP_ WHERE UP_.USERID = #{loginUser.id} AND UP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP_.TARGETID = OT.ANALYSISORGID) )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.RUNID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS NOT IN ('done') AND OT.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId} AND OT.PROJID = #{projId} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.RUNID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS = 'done' AND OT.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId} AND OT.PROJID = #{projId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP_ WHERE UP_.USERID = #{loginUser.id} AND UP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP_.TARGETID = OT.ANALYSISORGID) )
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.RUNID = T.ID and OT.PROJID = #{projId})
AND T.TESTID = #{testId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_REPORT_LINE B, T_EMC_ORDER_TASK C WHERE B.ORDERTASKID = C.ID AND T.ID = C.RUNID AND B.REPORTID = #{reportId} AND C.ANALYSISORGID = #{analysisOrgId} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B, T_EMC_FOLDER C WHERE T.ID = B.RUNID AND B.FOLDERID = C.ID AND C.STATUS = 'draw' AND C.PROJID = #{projId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT CBC WHERE CBC.TARGETID = CONCAT('T_EMC_RUN$',T.ID) AND CBC.STATUS <> 'SUBMIT' AND CBC.USERID = #{approveUserId} )
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, C.EQUIPTNAME ASSISTEQUIPTNAME, D.EQUIPTNAME, D.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTCODE FROM T_EMC_RUN T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT C ON T.ASSISTEQUIPTID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT D ON T.EQUIPTID = D.ID WHERE T.ID = #{id}

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, C.SLOPE RN2, C.INTERCEPT RN3, C.COEFFICIENT RN4 FROM T_EMC_RUN A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CURVE C ON A.CURVEID = C.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID
